title: Austin Invests in Water, Sewers, Bridges
summary:
*   **Major Waterway & Drainage Upgrades:** Approved plans to improve Little Shoal Creek by modifying existing bridges, removing obstructing utility pipes, and funded a new storm sewer for the Hospital Block.
*   **Land for New Sewage Plant:** Authorized the purchase of property to serve as the site for a critical new sewage disposal plant.
*   **Future Bridge Engineering:** Hired a civil engineer to develop plans for new bridges across Waller Creek and Shoal Creek.

Councilman Powell presented the following communication:

Austin, Texas, November 10th 1915.
To the Hon Mayor and City Council ,
City of Austin, Texas.

Gentlemen :

Some months ago we had Mr Bantelof the Engineering department of the Universityto help us
in the work of making preliminary plans for the impro-vement of Little Shoal Creek from
the alley north of 7th street to 19th street A considerable amount of work was put in on
these plans and the grade lines of the bottem of the sewer were determined,the sizes of
the sewer for the entire entire distancewere carefully figured out ,and we are now ready
to take up the work of making detailed plans.
In these investigations it was found that we could use all of the stone arch bridgesalong
this creek except the 11th street arch which is entirely too small and will have to be
removed.Now ,in improving this waterway,the bottoms of these bridges will have to be dug
out,the walls underpinned and smoth cement bottoms will have to be put in.This character
of work is difficult for a con-tractor to figure on and the main thing that he will
consider in making his price on work like this will be to get them high enough,in which
case the City will be required to pay the maximum price instead of a reasonable price ,and
I recomm end that the City go to work and have these bridges put in shape for connecting
up with the rest of the work when it is undertaken.If we do this work we should start it
now in order that we may get out of the way of the contractor so there will be no
confusion and delay caused by our getting in his way ,and I recommend that we start this
work at once and that an appropriation from the Permanent Street fund for the amount of
twenty five hundred(x,2,500) dollars be made to carry on this work throughout the balance
of the year.
Through all of these bridges along this drain there are a great many pipe lines which very
seriously obstruct the flow of water by catching drift and debrisand stopping up the water
way.These pipes belong to the Sewer department, the Water and Light department,and to the
Gas Co,and I recommend that the Cou-oil at once order these pipes to be removed and placed
either over or under the drain way.It will take sometime to do this,and even if no ore is
ever done to the creek chanel,conditions will be very much improved.

Improvement
Little Shoal
Creek.

Know all me by these presents, that we, Chester Thrasher, as principal and American Surety
Co of New York as surety, are held and firmly bound unto Honorable A P Wooldridge, Mayor
of the City of Austin, Texas, and his successors in Office in the sum of one hundred
thousand ($100,000.00) dollars , good and lawful money of the United States of America,
for the payment of which well and truly to be made , we hereby bind ourselves, our heirs,
executors, administrators and successors, jointly and severally, firmly by these presents.
The condition of the above obligation is such that, whereas, the above bounden Chester
Thrasher was on the 2nd day of May 1915, duly elected City Treasurer of the City of
Austin, Texas, in accordance with Article 7, Section 16 of the City Charter of the City of
Austin, Texas, as shown by the records of the City of Austin, Texas; Now, if the said
Chester Thrasher, as such City Treasurer of the City of Austin, Texas, shall securely
keep, strictly account for, and pay over in accordance with law, all monies that may come
into his hands as such City Treasurer, and shall otherwise faithfully perform and
discharge all of the duties that are or may hereafter be imposed upon him by or under the
Charter or the ordinances of the City of Austin, Texas, or by the order of the City
Council of the City of Austin, Texas, or by any other lawfully constituted authority, then
this obligation shall be null and void, otherwise to remain in full force and effect.
Provided, however, and this obligation is upon the further express condition , that no
suit, action or other proceeding shall be commenced or instituted against the principal or
surety on this bond after the 2nd day of May Nineteen hundred and nineteen( 1919) In
testimony whereof , we hereunto sign our names on this the 9th day of November 1915.
(Sgd) Chester Thrasher, Principal .
American Surety Company of New York.
By Jas E Lucy, Resident Vice President
( Seal) Attest, W T Decherd, Resident Secretary.
